title: Migration 005 downgrade leaves whisper_timeout_minutes behind on non-SQLite databases
reasoning: The non-SQLite upgrade adds three columns: whisper_provider, whisper_model, and whisper_timeout_minutes. The non-SQLite downgrade drops only whisper_model and whisper_provider, so downgrading does not restore the prior schema. This is a direct upgrade/downgrade contract mismatch.
reproduction: On a non-SQLite Alembic context, upgrade through revision 005 and then downgrade to 004. The whisper_timeout_minutes column remains in client_config.
recommendation: Drop whisper_timeout_minutes in the non-SQLite downgrade together with the other columns, or intentionally document why the downgrade is partial.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No linked migration downgrade tests were supplied.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add a migration round-trip test for revision 005 on the supported non-SQLite dialect path that verifies all columns added by upgrade are removed by downgrade.
